thread:
Nina: FYI vendor reported 6x H100s from APAC allotment failed POST on arrival. They offered two remediation paths: (A) air-replace 3 units from EU pool now + 3 later after QA, or (B) full reship from APAC (7d). Need quick ops + finance call.
Carlos: thanks. AWB? customs?
Nina: AWB AL-3091-APAC, stuck at FRA customs per vendor note. Vendor says air ETA ~48h, surcharge ~€1,150/unit; APAC reship no surcharge but 7d delay.
Vendor-AeroLogistics: confirm we can split shipment: 3x air now, 3x sea later. We can absorb half the expedite fee if Redwood covers the remainder and returns DOAs within 14 days.
Priya: how many spare slots in EU staging?
Carlos: we have 3 available in AMS staging cluster and one slot in FRA transit. Dock window needed and serial-validation hold on onboarding.
Finance-Bot: quick calc: surcharge €1,150; vendor covers 50% = €575; brokerage estimated €275/unit. Redwood net per unit ~€850. Approve? pending manual sign-off.
Nina: operational impact: APAC training windows scheduled next week rely on those GPUs. Delay cost estimated ~$10k/day if we lose 3 units for 4 days. Air+loaner likely cheaper.
Priya: request vendor provide loaner GPUs to avoid burn on dedicated pools. Vendor, can you confirm loaner availability and terms?
Vendor-AeroLogistics: 2x loaners available immediately for up to 10 days with signed LOA and pre-provisioned return label.
Carlos: will accept loaners but tag and lock to non-prod. Commands used for tagging: 
./inventory tag H100-LOAN-01 temp-loaner
./inventory restrict H100-LOAN-01 non-prod
Nina: Maria from customs will send docs to vendor; need invoice updated to include PO 48200 and brokerage line to avoid clearance delay.
Vendor-AeroLogistics: invoice updated and sent to customs contact on file.
Finance-Bot: finance can greenlight covering €850/unit expedite fee once vendor sends signed cost-share confirmation and loaner addendum.
Nina: I'm putting dock hold for tonight 21:00-22:00 CET if release happens. Carlos will schedule onboarding freeze until serials validated.
Dock-Bot: AWB AL-3091-APAC status: "Docs Received - Under Review". ETA clearance 8-12h.
Carlos: final check - do we accept partial air replace + loaners and pay €850/unit? Need infra and finance thumbs.
Priya: infra OK, will coordinate tagging + staging.
Finance-Bot: finance OK pending vendor sign docs.
Vendor-AeroLogistics: cost-share and loaner addendum emailed at 1720001200.
Nina: proceeding with air partial replace + loaners. Redwood covers €850/unit for expedite/brokerage. Vendor to return DOAs within 14 days and covers remaining fees. Any objections within 20m, speak now.
Carlos: approved.
Priya: approved.
Finance-Bot: approved.
Dock-Bot: AWB AL-3091-APAC status changed to "Released to Forwarder" at 1720001234.
Nina: Received release, prepping dock. Will drop PO link and DOA serials in #vendors channel. Thanks team :thumbsup:
